purpose: Define provenance-complete inputs for SI-next relationship, uncertainty, lineage, and multi-parent diagnostics without modifying or re-scoring any physical result already frozen under v0.2.

rules: All three views remain separately reported.
No master score may be computed by this candidate contract.
If any required view is NONIDENTIFIABLE or NOT_MEASURED, the cross-view relationship remains unresolved.
The contract does not define a new physical support threshold.

uncertainty_U.rule: Uncertainty and refusal states propagate forward. Precision in one view cannot erase unresolved uncertainty in another required view.

lineage.identifiability_rule: A unique dominant correspondence is not sufficient for identifiability. An identifiable lineage step requires uncertainty-resolved dominance or nonoverlapping uncertainty intervals under a method fixed before target interpretation.
lineage.flow_semantics: Row-normalized lineage flow is descriptive relative correspondence only. It is not probability, causal fraction, inheritance percentage, or a promotion score.
lineage.threshold_policy: No physical carrier-match cutoff is supplied by this contract.

multi_parent.purpose: Prepare source-specific and interaction-specific counterfactual diagnostics when multiple candidate parents are independently defined.
multi_parent.exact_mobius_rule: Exact subset Mobius decomposition is admissible only when every one of the 2^n source subsets, including the empty subset and full set, has a provenance-complete response under one frozen protocol, with common units and response shape.
multi_parent.source_limit_role: computational complexity guard only, not a physical threshold
multi_parent.normalization_policy: Source effects and interactions must not be normalized to sum to one or 100 percent.
multi_parent.partial_subset_policy: An incomplete subset manifest may support explicitly partial diagnostics but must not be labeled an exact Mobius decomposition.

hard_refusals: missing scalar, modal, or conglomeration relationship view
cross-view master score requested or reported
physical threshold introduced by SI-next ingestion
SI-next used to override a v0.2 physical label or score
post-target mapping or threshold fitting presented as prospective
lineage step called identifiable without uncertainty provenance
lineage relative flow interpreted as probability, causal fraction, inheritance percentage, or promotion score
multi-parent source effects normalized to sum to one or 100 percent
duplicate or unknown source IDs in subset manifests
mixed response units or response shapes across a purported exact decomposition
incomplete 2^n subset manifest presented as exact Mobius decomposition
target kinetics or chi used to choose lineage mapping or source protocol
